title: Maximum Number of Subsequences After One Inserting
summary: Given a string s made of uppercase English letters, you can insert at most one uppercase English letter anywhere in the string.
statement: Given a string s made of uppercase English letters, you can insert at most one uppercase English letter anywhere in the string. Determine the greatest number of 'LCT' subsequences that can be created by performing at most one insertion.
constraints: Insert at most one uppercase letter anywhere.
Maximize the number of LCT subsequences.
hints: Only inserting L, C, or T can help; each contributes an existing CT pair, an L-before/T-after product, or an LC pair.
Count existing LCT subsequences and the best marginal contribution of one insertion.
Track L left and T right for C insertion, plus total LC and CT pairs for endpoint insertions.
Every new LCT uses the inserted character in exactly one of these three roles, so the best marginal count is complete.
editorial: Every new LCT uses the inserted character in exactly one of these three roles, so the best marginal count is complete.

tests.explanation: Inserting L at the beginning doubles the single existing subsequence.
Inserting L at the beginning produces four subsequences.
